answer.worked: The zero of the given cubic is $x=\frac12$, so the reciprocal has vertical asymptote $x=\frac12$. The reciprocal preserves the sign: it is negative for $x<\frac12$ and positive for $x>\frac12$. As $x\to\frac12^-$, $y\to-\infty$; as $x\to\frac12^+$, $y\to+\infty$. As $x\to-\infty$, $y\to0^-$; as $x\to+\infty$, $y\to0^+$. The point $(0,-1)$ remains $(0,-1)$. These features match graph A. Correct answer: A.
